{{Quote|Ryoo Thule now lives in the lake district of Naboo in the family villa called Varykino. In Translucence Cove.|The [[Director of Essentials]] to [[Malorum]]|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>}}
'''Translucence Cove''' was a small bay area in [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] of the Lake Country on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] grandmother [[Ryoo Thule]] lived in seclusion in the cove.
